summary: The table presents data on rate reduction and percent improvement across various branches of the Department of Defense (DOD) from fiscal year 2002 (FY 02) to fiscal year 2009 (FY 09). It compares the performance of the Army, Navy, Marines, Air Force, and Defense Logistics, showing significant improvements in each category. The Marines achieved the highest rate reduction of 37.1 and a 50% improvement, while the Navy had the highest percent improvement at 46%. The data highlights the overall efficiency gains within the DOD over the specified period.
